links.outcome: Validity of scientific articles and evidence cited by LLMs when verifying medical causal hypotheses
links.effect: Eight LLMs showed strong recall but often performed poorly at providing valid scientific articles and evidence for support and at rejecting unsupported hypotheses (1,067 annotation points, 17 hypotheses).
links.quote: Our analysis shows that while LLMs exhibit strong recall, they often perform poorly at providing valid scientific articles and evidence for support and at rejecting unsupported hypotheses.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating the accuracy and scientific evidence grounding/retrieval of eight large language models when verifying medical causal hypotheses.
